comments.author: yesenadam
comments.why: Hamming asks if you work on the most important problems.
comments.text: This reads a lot like Hamming's talk You and Your Research applied to programming. It's the last lecture in a wonderful 31-lecture course, about maths, computers, physics, technology, illustrated through Hamming's life. He'd spend his lunch hours chatting with people at Bell Labs, asking them if they were working on the most important problems in their field, and if not, why not?! [VIDEO]

But I left the word "Research" in the title because that is what I have most studied. ”
